To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the DRD4 7R allele was significantly associated with higher scores on the TPQ subscales Exploratory Excitable and Extravagant, and on the total Novelty Seeking score, but not with the Impulsiveness or the Monotony Avoidance subscale.

the DRD4 7-repeat allele is associated with increased scores on the TPQ subscales Exploratory Excitable and Extravagant, and that this association is independent of the effects of the DRD3 Ser9Gly polymorphism and age.

the long allele of the dopamine receptor D4 (DRD4), exon III, is associated with higher levels of Novelty Seeking and Extraversion, but not with Impulsiveness, and that the association between DRD4 exon-III genotype and Novelty Seeking is independent of the effects of other polymorphisms of the dopamine receptor genes.

the relationship between the DRD4 receptor gene and the personality trait of Novelty seeking, which is a major dimension of personality in Cloninger’s tridimensional model of personality.1,15,17,18 The dopamine D4 receptor gene has been identified as a promising candidate gene for this personality trait.
